newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Changan Auto to sell half of B shr issue to Suzuki.
newsitem.headline: Changan Auto to sell half of B shr issue to Suzuki.

text.p: Chongqing Changan Automobile Co Ltd said on Friday Suzuki Motor Corp had agreed to take up half of its planned 250 million B share issue, giving Suzuki a 16.5 percent stake in the Chinese automaker.
Suzuki, a strategic business partner of Chongqing Changan, will pay 2.96 yuan (HK$2.75) per share against the planned issue price range of HK$1.77 to HK$1.95, Chongqing Changan said.
The Chongqing-based Chinese automaker said it had received necessary approvals to issue 250 million B class shares, for foreign investors only, to be listed in Shenzhen at end October.
The issue would raise HK$565-578 million, it said.
The pro forma fully diluted price earnings ratio for the shares was 6.05-6.67 times while fully diluted earnings per share was HK$0.292-0.293, it said.
Changan Automobile makes mini-vans, mini-trucks and alto mini-sedans under the "Changan" brand.
It also makes mini-automobile engines under the "Jiangling" name for its own automobile production and for sale in China, the company said.
The proceed would be used in the construction of vehicle production lines, engine production lines and a research and development centre, and as working capital, it said.
